headline._: One vendor reports 25 servers rooted, with no victim named and no evidence shown. Still no organisation confirms a compromise.
headline.exec: Nothing new that needs a decision. Still no organisation says it was hit. CISA's deadline for US agencies was today.
headline.general: Nothing new for you. If someone runs your website, ask them if it is updated.
headline.security: Dream Research's 25 rooted servers (three in an unnamed US government-affiliated environment): a report, no victim, no evidence, not counted as confirmed. KEV deadline reached.
headline.engineer: Nothing new to install. Confirm the fixed version is what is running.
headline.journalist: A vendor's report is not a victim: keep Dream Research's 25 servers apart from "confirmed hacked". Still no organisation confirmed, as of 17:13 UTC.
headline.researcher: 703 sources by the 18:12 UTC export; 3 published today. One report (Dream Research) on the compromise ledger, unconfirmed; the compromise line's as-of moved to 17:13 UTC.

items.text: A vendor, Dream Research, reports that a campaign rooted 25 servers, three of them in an unnamed US government-affiliated environment, on 26 October. It names no victim and publishes no evidence; The Next Web says it has not verified it. The newsroom carries it as a dated, attributed report, not a confirmed compromise.
items.before: 2 vendor claims of success, both withdrawn
items.src: Dream Research via The Hacker News, The Next Web; the journalist (state v6), the correspondent

items.text: "Has anyone actually been hacked through php2shell?" gets a dated update: still no organisation confirms a compromise.
